data.narrative:
Aalyria, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Chris Taylor, is currently valued at $1.3B post-money following $130M+ in cumulative fundraising. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private frontier-tech peers in the same sector.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the $1.3B base valuation, implying $2.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector comparables at Series B/C stages—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—yields a median of $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using a 24.4x price-to-sales multiple across the sector cannot be applied, as target revenue is not disclosed. The three-point range across applicable methods spans $1.7B to $2.8B, with a median of $2.2B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B–$2.8B, anchored near $2.2B. Material uncertainties include significant valuation dispersion within the peer set ($1.1B–$8.0B) and the absence of revenue data, which limits public-market triangulation. Series C fundraising outcomes and customer contract visibility would materially inform refinement of this estimate.
